title: Add the website to your phone
caption: Add this website to your phone’s home screen and it opens like an app. iPhone: open it in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Android: open it in Chrome, tap the menu, then Add to Home screen. It then works with no signal, opens full screen, keeps every helpline two taps away, and stays up to date on its own.

title: Balcony safety & cleanliness
caption: Balcony safety & cleanliness — keep your balcony clean and contained, and never throw water, dust, cigarette butts or waste from balconies

title: Corridors must be kept clean & clear
caption: Corridors must be kept clean & clear — no footwear, cycles, furniture or storage in the common corridors. Keep the passage tidy and unobstructed for everyone.

title: Parking rules
caption: Park within your own allotted slot and inside the markings. No-parking zones and fire lanes are strictly enforced — vehicles are locked and fined Rs 200 a day for two-wheelers and Rs 500 for four-wheelers. No waste or storage in parking areas, and cycles belong in flat parking only.

title: Security at the main gate
caption: Residents: affix the society sticker and register your vehicle for automatic access. Guests and non-registered vehicles must use Gate 1 for entry checks. Do not misuse the entry and exit lanes — Gates 3 and 5 are planned for exit only.

title: Swimming pool usage rules
caption: Proper swimwear is mandatory. Children must be supervised by an adult at all times. No food or glass items near the pool. The pool is for registered residents only — guests are not allowed.

title: Gym guidelines
caption: Under-14s are not allowed in the gym. Do not drop weights or misuse equipment — place them gently and re-rack after use. Limit sessions to 30 minutes during peak hours so everyone gets a chance, and keep the shared audio at a moderate volume.

title: Residents’ behaviour towards support staff
caption: Treat all support staff with dignity and courtesy — a smile and kind words go a long way. Do not be rude, dismissive or abusive towards support staff; mistreating them creates an unhealthy environment and is serious misconduct.

title: Resident & support staff interaction
caption: Support staff are valued members of our society’s ecosystem and courteous interaction is expected at all times. They may not be engaged for private work inside flats beyond their defined scope. Verbal abuse, intimidation or disrespectful behaviour is strictly unacceptable — report any misconduct to the Maintenance Manager or Core Committee.

title: Save water — use it judiciously
caption: Boond boond se banta hai kal ka savera. Close taps when not in use, use a bucket instead of a shower, run full loads in washing machines, report leaks promptly, and water plants in the morning or evening.
